policy: Generated backlog is assignment data. null acceptance means not assessed. A phase gate requires all phase tasks, evidence and review; done inventory does not pass a phase.

current_backlog.role: Revised assignment after the P0 gate. For tasks that are not started, its acceptance, verification, delivery_slice, measurement and evidence_tier_min fields are authoritative; refresh the tracker criterion when a task starts.

tiers.A: Tracker entry with commands, tests and result plus checks.json written by tools/dev/check.py.
tiers.B: Tier A plus risk-selected sanitizer results and a short ownership, lifetime or concurrency note.
tiers.C: Full reviewed package: anonymized metadata, raw reports kept outside the repository, decision record.

evidence_policy.tier_selection: Use at least the backlog evidence_tier_min. Raise to B when the change touches native resources, threads, queues, callbacks or stop/cancel paths. Phase gates and tasks with measurement are C.
evidence_policy.tracker_entry: New entries reference the evidence directory and its checks.json instead of listing every file; list individual files only for criteria that need a specific artifact.
evidence_policy.historical_entries: Entries completed before this policy keep their detailed evidence lists.

verification_policy.every_change: Whitespace, clang-format on changed native sources, release build and CTest excluding the long PTS conformance label.
verification_policy.phase_gate: Run tools/dev/check.py --gate for the full matrix.
verification_policy.unavailable_checks: A report with unavailable checks is incomplete, not passed, and must be reported as such.

measurement_policy: Run reference series or benchmarks only for tasks whose backlog measurement field is reference-series or benchmark. Other tasks use correctness tests and make no performance claim.

delivery_slices.policy: A slice is delivered in one commit that closes all of its task IDs; each ID keeps its own acceptance, evidence and status. Phases without slices deliver one task ID per commit.

Test-pattern create reuses a shared cache without a second PSO compile; GPU handles are never serialized.

acceptance.criterion: Pixel/alpha golden ukazuje správné souřadnice a blending; skeleton exportuje krátké MP4/PNG bez TS hot-path.

P3-009.notes: Extended DrawOp with ellipse/rounded-rect/line, CPU src-over goldens, FrameState-oriented WorldPrimitive lowering, Metal SDF PrimitiveRenderer, and a native walking-skeleton smoke that evaluates frames, stages RGBA and publishes via VideoSink plus PNG.

acceptance.criterion: Golden fixtures pokrývají složité cesty a hraniční geometrii; statická geometrie se neteseluje per-frame.

P3-010.notes: Added production geometry module with path flatten, private libtess2 fill tessellation, in-tree stroke expand and a compile-once PathGeometryCache. Pin is v1.0.2 (SGI-B-2.0). Unit goldens cover holes, winding rules, degenerates, budgets and cache hit/miss so static geometry is not re-tessellated per frame.

acceptance.criterion: Více shodných objektů používá méně draw calls bez změny pixelů.

P3-011.notes: Added instance batching in render-core: consecutive shape ops that share texture_binding coalesce into one DrawBatch/instance buffer while preserving source order. Metal primitives upload a 64-byte-stride instance buffer and issue one drawPrimitives per batch. CPU goldens keep pixels identical; instance-batch-bench reports draw-call reduction (non_certified_dev_baseline).

acceptance.criterion: Chybný soubor a obří bitmapa se odmítnou bez GPU crash.

P3-012.notes: Added asset-pipeline bitmap decode for PNG (stb_image) and WebP (libwebp decode subset) with input/dimension/pixel budgets, straight or premultiplied alpha, and assume-sRGB/ignore-ICC import policy. Probe rejects oversized headers before allocation; corrupt and unknown inputs fail closed without GPU.

acceptance.criterion: Statické SVG importy jsou reprodukovatelné a externí odkazy se nenačtou.

P3-013.notes: Added asset-pipeline SVG security pre-scan and static subset import to Path2f. Scripts, handlers, and external URL references are rejected before NanoSVG parse; image/filter/mask/use fail closed. NanoSVG is a private dependency (pinned commit).

acceptance.criterion: Změna bitmapy invaliduje jen relevantní komponenty; poškozená/nekompatibilní cache se bezpečně odmítne nebo přebuduje.

P3-014.notes: Added content-hash asset cache with separate disk (normalized RGBA blobs, IAC1 + format version) and process-local GPU slots that are never serialized. SHA-256 covers source bytes and compile flags; changing one asset invalidates only its GPU binding unless another id still shares the hash; corrupt or version-skewed blobs fail closed for rebuild.

acceptance.criterion: Atlas hit rate a staging bytes jsou reportované; výsledek bez pixel bleeding.

P3-015.notes: Added CPU texture atlas in asset-pipeline: shelf packing with mandatory padding gutter (anti-bleed), content-key hit stats, optional box-filter mips, and batched dirty-region staging uploads that stay zero once sprites are marked resident. texture-atlas-bench reports hit_rate/staging_bytes as non_certified_dev_baseline.

acceptance.criterion: Čeština, ligatury a combining marks mají správné rozložení v referenčních fixtures.

P3-016.notes: Added typography module with RAII FreeType/HarfBuzz/ICU adapters, pinned Noto Sans + DejaVu Sans fallback fonts, and shaping fixtures for Czech diacritics, combining marks, and fi ligatures. External deps resolved via pkg-config with version pins; no implicit system font catalog.

acceptance.criterion: Static text is not fully laid out and rasterized again for every frame.

P3-017.notes: Added CPU GlyphAtlas over TextureAtlas (font fingerprint/size/flags cache, in-flight pin eviction) and MetalGlyphAtlas with registry-backed page textures retained across SubmissionContext frames. font-atlas-bench shows warm_shape_calls=0 and warm_raster_calls=0 (non_certified_dev_baseline).

acceptance.criterion: Vnořené clips a masky fungují i přes několik vrstev.

P3-018.notes: Added GPU-neutral ClipScript compositor (nested scissors + shape masks) and Metal ClipMaskRenderer using MTLScissorRect plus stencil increment/decrement. Mask compositing goldens compare CPU vs Metal.

acceptance.criterion: Stíny nezpůsobí změnu blending pořadí; vynechaný efekt nepřidá pass; probe je registrovaná feature.

P3-019.notes: Added screen-space hard/soft shadow planning and CPU golden raster: separate shadow passes sort before main_color, inactive features add no passes, soft shadows use quality-tier separable box blur, and paper_layered_depth_probe is a registered capability hook (not a style fork).

acceptance.criterion: Test patterns odpovídají tolerancím i při poloprůhledném překryvu.

P3-020.notes: Added linear-light premultiplied compositor in render-core with Rec.709/sRGB-transfer encode, plus export-core flatten/handoff into EncodableFrame/FrameBridge. Semi-transparent overlay goldens and a small MP4 roundtrip stay within defined channel tolerances; legacy gamma primitive paths remain intact.

acceptance.criterion: Offscreen uzly nevytvářejí draw op; porovnání s unculled referencí souhlasí.

P3-021.notes: Added viewport visibility/culling and opaque-then-transparent draw sorting in render-core: fully offscreen/invisible/empty-clip items emit no draws with counters, culled pass pixels match the unculled golden, and alpha order stays back-to-front after the opaque batch.

acceptance.criterion: Známé synthetic workloads ověří p99/CPU/memory formule; GPU host notification není vydávána za device execution time.

P3-022.notes: Added hot-path telemetry in runtime: FrameSamples-backed instrument with exact nearest-rank admission/frame/GPU-host summaries, BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL CPU totals, memory peak aggregation that keeps missing metrics null, and explicit separation of host-observed GPU completion from device counters.

acceptance.criterion: motion frame --at 450 funguje bez renderování předchozích snímků.

A verified project example exists for all 3 styles without internal imports.
The API linter detects unintended public types and forbidden imports.
Older locked examples load or fail with a clear unsupported-version error.
A clean checkout produces identical IR offline and detects modified assets.
The CLI works from shell scripts and CI without a UI; every error has a defined exit code.
Failure before publication preserves the old target; failure after publication truthfully acknowledges the existing output and its durability without claiming a false rollback.
Stop in every state and late callbacks cause no use-after-free or deadlock; cancellation after publication must not pretend that the video does not exist.
Expected failures cause no unhandled exceptions and temporary files are cleaned up.
Slow-sink/oldest-frame faults do not increase limits, drop export frames or cause busy-spinning.
Memory pressure causes controlled rejection rather than OOM or a silent quality downgrade.
Reproducible inputs cause no panic, memory explosion or infinite loop.
The importer permits no network access, traversal, arbitrary code execution or uncontrolled dimensions.
Traversal and external paths outside the sandbox are rejected.
Exceeding the declared profile produces a predictable error before OOM.
All reference MP4 files pass automated validation, which fails on invalid metadata.
Colors and brightness stay within the defined tolerance on the target macOS.
Supported API configurations are listed explicitly; unsupported configurations are reported.
Measured evidence is distinguished from design fixtures; inconsistent counts/formulas/quantiles or missing mandatory metrics invalidate certification.
Regression checks compare the same workload; a fixture/profile change is an explicit new baseline.

The supported complexity tier and performance limit are published; there is no OOM.

There is no fatal slowdown or working-set growth beyond the declared budget.
Invalid headers/imports/schemas and sanitizer/concurrency regressions block the PR; native coverage limits are documented.
A shader change without the correct layout or golden image blocks the PR.
An unreviewed pixel change or loss of readability fails the release gate.
No released example contains unapproved errors.
All distributed assets have appropriate permissions and no unresolved critical vulnerability remains.
A new developer can locate the module owner and extend a style without consulting internal GPU handles.
A clean installation following the tutorial produces all three videos.
Every documented common failure has reproduction steps and diagnostic information.
On a clean supported Mac, a binary distribution can be installed without locally compiling the renderer.
The v1.0 tag states compatible versions and migrations; release notes describe breaking changes.
All 3 MP4 files have 1080×1920/30fps, no audio track and content matching the three Style Bibles.
There is no premature release/reuse, double deletion or callback into a destroyed job; every resource has an owner/borrow/completion/limit contract.
K/E and the memory plateau are respected, with no dropped export frames, spin waits or deadlocks; every waiting path can be terminated.

Before publication the target is unchanged or absent; after publication only a valid MP4 exists with truthful status. SIGKILL is not presented as power-loss evidence; unsupported durable profiles are rejected.
Raw evidence matches the report and all units/intervals/profiles are explicit; design fixtures, lost samples and missing metrics cannot receive PASS.
Every MUST gate has actual evidence and PASS; ownership/concurrency/crash/measurement audits pass, with no blocking defect or unexplained missing metric.
Git tag v1.0.0 matches the tested build and package checksums.
